e2e_allowlist_entries.basis: table rows in e2e/ALLOWLIST.md (prose mentions of CI-A* do not count)
e2e_allowlist_entries.why: governed suppressions, but the register set 10 as the tooling threshold

gates_without_proof.why: gaps.md G8 — 'is it passing' and 'can it fail' are different questions, and mac-build.yml answered the first correctly for three months while being incapable of the second

mypy_errors.note: Set from CI, never from a dev machine: pyproject pins mypy>=1.13 (a floor), so the count moves with whatever a fresh install resolves. Measured twice now — 238 local / 239 CI on 3 Sep 2026, and 148 local / 149 CI on 4 Sep, the second time because CI resolved mypy 2.3.1 against this Mac's 2.3.0. Move it with `gh workflow run ratchet-tighten.yml` and `--adopt`; the local run reports but cannot lower it.
mypy_errors.why: gaps.md G3 — soft since it was added, which is how it reached 238

pytest_skip_sites.basis: skipif + bare skip + runtime pytest.skip() across tests/
pytest_skip_sites.note:
24 -> 25 on 20 Sep 2026, deliberately. tests/test_pii_spacy_lazy_fetch.py's test_a_path_delivered_model_redacts_with_no_package_installed runtime-skips when en_core_web_lg is absent. Same class as test_pii_audit's skipif, which this ceiling has always tolerated: a test whose input is a 400 MB model nobody commits, guarded so it says so rather than failing on a fresh clone. It sits inside a @pytest.mark.slow test, so CI never reaches it either way.

23 -> 24 on 12 Sep 2026, deliberately. tests/test_media_time_meta.py's TestAgainstTheCorpus is skipif'd on the format-torture corpus being on disk (IMG_2544.MOV) -- the same class as test_no_fake_success_acceptance's 'input absent: gitignored trial-runs data', which this ceiling has always tolerated: a test whose INPUT cannot be committed, guarded so it says so rather than failing on a fresh clone. Not new debt of a new kind.

Raised because it had stopped being a ratchet and started being a blocker: PR #143 (frontend deps, zero Python files touched, verified green locally) could not auto-merge because it inherited this red from main. A ceiling that holds unrelated correct work hostage is how a gate gets switched off, which is the failure this whole file exists to prevent.

22 -> 23 on 3 Sep 2026, deliberately. The live-LLM AutoCode harness used to ERROR when the Anthropic account ran out of credit, so every local close-out reported 3 errors that were not regressions - noise that trains people to ignore a red summary line, which is the same defect as a skip reading as a pass, only louder. It now skips with a message that leads 'SKIPPED, NOT PASSED', per G2's 'make the skip loud'. This brings it into line with the other two slow files, which already guarded (test_pii_audit skipif, test_no_fake_success_acceptance runtime skip) - it is the third of three, not new debt. A genuine BAD_REQUEST/UNKNOWN still fails.
pytest_skip_sites.why: a skip reads as a pass in every summary line — gaps.md G2

pytest_slow_marked.note: 7 -> 9 on 20 Sep 2026, deliberately, and it is why this gate had been red since 13 Sep. Both additions need en_core_web_lg (400 MB), which is why they are slow-marked: test_pii_score_bar's test_a_phone_with_no_context_word_is_redacted_end_to_end pins the measured threshold defect against the real detector, and test_pii_spacy_lazy_fetch's test_a_path_delivered_model_redacts_with_no_package_installed proves the assumption the .dmg and TestFlight deliveries rest on — a model directory with no importable package. Neither can run in CI without a 400 MB download in every matrix cell, so the coverage is given up on purpose. Note the counter also matches prose: of the 9, five are real decorators and four are the marker being explained inside a docstring. Worth knowing before hunting for four tests that do not exist.
pytest_slow_marked.why: excluded from CI by -m 'not slow', so each one is CI coverage given up
